name: Wausau
tagline: Affordable Midwest Living with Rib Mountain Recreation and Small-Town Heart
description: Wausau is a small, affordable city in central Wisconsin that punches above its weight for outdoor recreation. Rib Mountain State Park offers year-round hiking and skiing at Granite Peak — the highest vertical drop in the Midwest. The Wisconsin River runs through downtown, and the surrounding Northwoods provide endless opportunities for fishing, kayaking, and cross-country skiing. Healthcare is solid through the Aspirus system, and the tight-knit community offers a genuine small-town quality of life at a fraction of what larger Midwest cities charge. For FIRE retirees who value outdoor access, low costs, and quiet living, Wausau is a hidden gem.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.safetyRating: High – crime rates below national average, safe neighborhoods throughout
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Central Wisconsin Airport (CWA) — 10 min drive; also Appleton (ATW) and Green Bay (GRB) within 90 min
quickFacts.climate: Continental with cold, snowy winters and warm, humid summers; significant snowfall November through March

housing.description: Basic older 1BR or nice studio downtown, on the west side, or in Weston (RentCafe low end $695–830)

healthcare.description: Subsidized ACA Silver (Wisconsin uses healthcare.gov) with income under the 2026 400%-FPL cliff (~$62,600); assumes an early retiree (45–55), older retirees should budget more. Above the cliff this climbs toward WI's full unsubsidized price. (WI did NOT take standard Medicaid expansion, so a lean retiree relies on the subsidized marketplace, not Medicaid)

transportation.description: An older paid-off economy car; low/min full coverage (~$110–140/mo WI), fuel, winter tires

entertainment.description: Rib Mountain / Northwoods recreation, a Granite Peak pass amortized, the Leigh Yawkey Woodson Art Museum

1M.lifestyle: A basic older one-bedroom or a nice studio downtown or in Weston anchors a quiet, low-cost life at rents well below a capital metro. Cooking at home is the default, a paid-off economy car with winter tires is essential in central Wisconsin, and healthcare rests on a subsidized Silver plan tied to keeping income under the ACA cliff. Rib Mountain hikes, Wisconsin River trails, and the Northwoods fill the weekends. Heating is a real winter line, but the overall base is low enough that the budget holds without constant strain.

2M.lifestyle: A newer one-bedroom near Rib Mountain or in Weston, dining out several times a month, and a newer used car for the winters. The low cost base leaves a healthy margin for summer lake-country trips or weekend drives to Madison and Minneapolis.

10M.lifestyle: The ceiling of what money buys in the Wausau area — a luxury lakefront estate on Lake Wausau or the chain lakes, routine fine dining, and a luxury AWD vehicle with a recreational second car. Full household help handles cleaning, grounds, and snow removal, and concierge medicine sits atop a top-tier unsubsidized domestic plan. Boats, premium Granite Peak access, flexible travel via CWA, and Northwoods estate recreation round out a well-staffed life where the genuine lakefront niche rivals a far larger metro.
